skill.name: ego-browser
skill.description: Connect agents to the ego lite browser for website interaction and data extraction using existing sessions. Includes setup guidance and GitHub, Google, and X helpers.
skill.summary: Use ego lite browser sessions for agent workflows, search extraction, and website investigation.
skill.author: citrolabs

security_audit.summary: Of 67 static alerts, 65 are false positives and two identify real privileged installer behavior. Two additional findings identify Gatekeeper quarantine removal and instructions to bypass Windows SmartScreen. No evidence found of credential exfiltration or audit-targeted prompt injection in the reviewed files; the external browser and generated runtime guide remain unreviewed.

remediation.issue: The installer retries operations with sudo, including installation of downloaded packages without explicit publisher verification.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer user-scoped installation, require approval before elevation, and verify package signatures against the expected publisher before privileged installation.

remediation.issue: The macOS installer recursively removes quarantine attributes from downloaded and existing applications.
remediation.suggestion: Remove automatic quarantine stripping and validate application signing and notarization before launch. Preserve Gatekeeper checks and document normal approval procedures.

remediation.issue: Windows troubleshooting instructs users to bypass SmartScreen without verifying the installer.
remediation.suggestion: Replace unconditional bypass guidance with publisher-signature verification and instructions to stop when the publisher or download provenance cannot be verified.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Gatekeeper Quarantine Removal
semantic_findings.description: The installer uses xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine on staged and existing applications before launch. Its comment explicitly states the purpose is preventing Gatekeeper from blocking first launch. This removes a download safety mechanism without explicit signing or notarization verification.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both xattr calls remove quarantine recursively, and main invokes the helper even for existing installations. The stated Gatekeeper-bypass purpose confirms the security impact.

semantic_findings.title: Unconditional SmartScreen Bypass Guidance
semantic_findings.description: Windows troubleshooting says to choose "More info" and then "Run anyway" when SmartScreen blocks the installer. It provides no publisher-signature verification condition before overriding the warning, increasing the risk of running an untrusted installer.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly recommend overriding SmartScreen without checking publisher identity. This is unsafe installation guidance, not evidence that the vendor binary is malicious.

content.value_statement: Browser workflows often require existing logins, interactive pages, and repeated data collection. This skill connects agents to ego lite and provides setup guidance and reusable extraction helpers.
actual_capabilities: Load version-matched browser usage instructions through the installed ego-browser CLI.
Guide ego lite installation, onboarding, CLI discovery, and runtime readiness checks on macOS and Windows.
Search GitHub repositories and extract repository metadata or open issue titles and numbers.
Extract Google search result titles, links, and snippets with bounded result limits.
Search X users and extract visible timeline post text, authors, handles, and timestamps.
Provide guidance for scoped cookie and storage cleanup while warning about profile-wide session loss.
limitations: Requires the separate ego lite desktop browser and user-completed onboarding; this package does not include the browser.
Detailed browser commands come from the installed runtime guide and cannot be fully verified from this package alone.
Extraction depends on website selectors, loaded content, authentication, and site availability; layout changes can break helpers.
The bundled installer supports macOS only and includes privileged operations and security-check bypasses; Windows installation is manual.

use_cases.title: Investigate Website Behavior
use_cases.description: Use an existing browser session to inspect an application and collect observations for a reproducible issue report.

use_cases.title: Compare GitHub Projects
use_cases.description: Search repositories and review open issue summaries to support dependency evaluation.

use_cases.title: Collect Search and Social Context
use_cases.description: Gather Google result snippets and visible X profile or timeline information for a source-linked research summary.

prompt_templates.title: Check Browser Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether ego-browser is available and read its version-matched guide. Report readiness without installing, upgrading, or changing browser state.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Search Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Google for [topic] using ego-browser. Summarize up to five visible results with titles, links, and snippets. Do not submit forms beyond search.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: collect a small set of search results.

prompt_templates.title: Review Repository Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the issue list for [owner]/[repository] using ego-browser. Summarize visible issue titles and numbers. Do not post comments or modify repository content.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: inspect a specified GitHub repository.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate an Authenticated Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [workflow] at [URL] using my authorized session. Read the runtime guide first. Report observations and evidence; request approval before account changes or profile-wide cleanup.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: investigate a workflow with session and state boundaries.

output: Recommended first step: Reload the affected page while bypassing its cache.
If the issue persists, consider clearing only the affected origin's storage.
Profile-wide cookie removal would sign out other sites and requires explicit approval.
No browser state has been changed.

best_practices: Read the installed runtime guide and confirm the target website, profile, and authorized account before interacting.
Verify installer provenance and publisher signatures; preserve operating-system protections and approve privileged operations explicitly.
Use bounded extraction and origin-scoped cleanup; request approval before account changes or profile-wide data deletion.
anti_patterns: Running the bundled installer automatically or bypassing Gatekeeper and SmartScreen warnings without independent verification.
Treating all authenticated browser sessions as authorization to submit forms, change accounts, or publish content.
Clearing the entire browser profile to resolve a single-site problem or assuming DOM selectors will remain stable.

faq.question: Does this skill include a browser?
faq.answer: No. It depends on the separate ego lite application, which provides the ego-browser CLI after onboarding.

faq.question: Can it use existing website logins?
faq.answer: The skill is designed for sessions available in ego lite. Access depends on the selected profile, completed sign-in, and your authorization.

faq.question: Which operating systems have setup guidance?
faq.answer: The package documents macOS and Windows. Its bundled installer script supports macOS only; other platforms require an available vendor build.

faq.question: Are all browser commands included in the package?
faq.answer: No. The entry skill loads the version-matched guide from the installed ego-browser command, so available commands depend on that installation.

faq.question: Is the bundled installer risk-free?
faq.answer: No. It can elevate privileges and remove macOS quarantine attributes. Windows troubleshooting also recommends a SmartScreen bypass; verify provenance and preserve security protections.

faq.question: Will clearing cookies affect other tabs?
faq.answer: Profile-wide cookie clearing affects all tabs and task spaces sharing that profile. Prefer site-scoped cleanup and approve broader deletion explicitly.
